quest.title: The Hunger of Many
quest.description: Everything comes to an end, all too abruptly. Without a shred of hesitation, you throw yourself into the fray along with everyone else...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1000, Mora x44000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Head to The Cat's Tail. You'll be safe there, especially with Miss Diona to watch over things. You can stay there until this is all over.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Really? Okay! I'll head over right away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? How are there monsters in the city?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: They are all monsters from Dragonspine. An attack is imminent, but fear not — we've been preparing for this.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: We've been monitoring the resurgence of Durin's life force. Its festering nature agitated these monsters. We knew it was only a matter of time before they advanced on Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: And so, we made preparations for an inevitable battle.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I was hoping you two could join me and provide assistance in the battle to come.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! Where's our first stop?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The top of the city wall.

talks.objective: Provide mobile support to various areas in the city

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't like being in the middle like this, especially on a bridge.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh? Look who it is!

dialogues.speaker: Frostarm Lawachurl
dialogues.text: Haaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Get back!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Phew, that was a close one... I suppose thanks are in order, Master Diluc. I appreciate the help.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: No need. I didn't intervene to save you. It was for my own convenience. You were in my way.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh? Well, let me get out of your hair, then. I suppose we could work together, but you would just melt my ice, anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Suit yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, alright, tell me... When did you notice something was off?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: The first trial.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah, because of the fake Hertha?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: No, because of you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Me? What did I do? My defense wasn't passionate enough?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: No. You weren't nervous enough.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Tell me, then, Master Diluc... When do you think I actually get nervous?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I suppose we'll see, won't we? Monsters incoming!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Heh, on second thought, best not to think about it!

talks.objective: Provide mobile support to various areas in the city

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Gotta say, when I saw you on the side of the road, I thought you were hurt, not about to whack me in the head!

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Oh, gosh, I'm so sorry about that! I was trying to run away, but I just couldn't keep going, so I pretended to be unconscious. Thought I could at least land a surprise hit on a monster that way...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #I get it. That's a pretty common tactic. Oh, {NICKNAME}, Albedo, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Looks like this person could use some help. We'll search for a <color=#00E1FFFF>place to keep civilians out of danger</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This area appears secure, so remain here in the meantime. We'll be back with an <color=#00E1FFFF>update</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sounds like a plan!

talks.objective: Provide mobile support to various areas in the city

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: They're here! Prepare for battle!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: On guard, everyone! Incoming monsters at 11 o'clock!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Looks like we've got... 25 Hilichurls, 2 Blazing Axe Mitachurls, and a bunch of different Slimes!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Prepare elemental countermeasures!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Roger that!

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: All units are now in position.

dialogues.speaker: Note
dialogues.text: Hertha!? Geez, your voice scared me just now...

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: What, still caught up on the imposter incident? I thought you knew about the plan...

dialogues.speaker: Note
dialogues.text: Well, after you up and disappeared one day, all Master Jean told me was that you'd be gone for a while on an important mission, and that it'd be better if people thought you were dead...

dialogues.speaker: Note
dialogues.text: And then, what do you know? Someone who looks exactly like you appears out of nowhere two days later! If Master Jean hadn't told me about your mission, I would have fallen for it hook, line, and sinker!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's quite a scary thought...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I get chills just thinking about it... A monster replacing someone close to you, and you're none the wiser...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Once this is over, these monsters won't be a threat to us again.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: A—Albedo! Are you okay? The trial wasn't too hard on you, was it? I'm sorry I couldn't be there. I was so worried...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Same here! I thought it was all real at one point. I was in complete shock!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: So, you didn't know, Amber? Then, it seems Eula did an excellent job at keeping the situation under wraps. And, no need to worry, you two. I'm no worse for wear.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That sounds like Eula, alright. She's like an impenetrable wall, that one. You're not getting a secret out of her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, for sure! She's someone you can really count on!

dialogues.speaker: Note
dialogues.text: Wait, so how did you decide Hertha should disappear again? After all this fighting, I can't seem to get it straight.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It was Kaeya's suggestion. He said the plan would work best with someone well-known and reputable without being too high-profile.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Naturally, Miss Hertha was the perfect choice. We needed to leave a hole in our organization, so she came up with the idea that she would "disappear."

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Ah, so that explains the rumor that someone had fallen during a mission... Of course, it didn't take long for that to get resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: No, because the imposter fell right into our trap. It was all part of the plan. First, we spread the rumor that Hertha was missing in action after some kind of incident.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The news came from Kaeya and Hertha's direct subordinates, which was important because we needed it to be credible. The imposter saw the gap in our ranks and couldn't help but take the bait.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It didn't take long for the fake Hertha to appear on the Knights' patrol route, claiming to have "survived her mission."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When did that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Over six months ago.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... So this has been a long time in the making!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes. And, our enemy was more meticulous than we expected. Monsters have been searching for Hertha's body in order to protect the imposter's identity, which is a more advanced way of thinking than Subject Two.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: So, we had to wait long enough to convince the fake Hertha that she had our trust.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Furthermore, we needed to give her time to gather evidence against me and convince herself she had enough to strike.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, how did the Knights' internal information even reach Durin and his monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: There's an informant among our ranks.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Barbatos has already tracked her down. She doesn't have his blessing, so she can't hear what we're talking about right now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Honestly, this whole situation almost gave Paimon a heart attack! All those awful accusations in the first trial, and you couldn't even defend yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It was to be expected. I couldn't just reveal the truth. It had to be at the right moment, or it would have given the imposter even more fuel to use against me.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: She would have demanded to know how I knew about Dragonspine and the monsters in disguise. And, if my true identity got out, the public's trust in me would be gone.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It was a trap, you see — argue back, and expose my origins, or keep my mouth shut, and be seen as a murderer. Credit where credit is due, it was well thought out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, thank goodness we were able to back her into a corner!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: #Indeed, and I have you to thank for that, {NICKNAME}. You probably don't know it, but you've been a part of the plan since the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Me? But I didn't even know there was a plan...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: And for that, you have my sincere apologies. I know I kept you in the dark, but I had a reason.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This might not sound intuitive, but I did it to make the plan even stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: From the beginning, I knew I had to leave the letters in my office for a fair and independent reader to discover — someone willing to seek the truth. Naturally, I thought of you.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I knew you would return for Windblume. I knew you would agree to attend the trial...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: And, I knew your sense of responsibility and justice as an Honorary Knight would compel you to start your own investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The fake Hertha — Subject Two — has met you on Dragonspine before. If she thought even you had lost faith in me, her confidence might get the best of her — the perfect time for us to strike.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Albedo's right — you were part of our plan from the start. I hope you don't take offense at our decision to keep that from you.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: And please, don't be too hard on Albedo. He was just doing his best to look out for Mondstadt. Enough people were involved in the plan as it was — we had no other choice.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The Honorary Knight and Paimon will always be friends of Mondstadt. We will never forget that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awww. That means a lot!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It is us who should be thanking you, Honorary Knight.

choices.text: Thank you for thinking of me. It was an honor to take part.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: Master Jean, headquarters should be secure for now.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: We responded in time and had enough manpower. We can even spare some for mobile support across the region.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Good. Our intel suggests that the monsters from Dragonspine could be disguised as Mondstadt citizens, so be sure to exercise caution.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, and my divination revealed there are also regular people under the influence of some strange power. Not all of them are monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes, so for those people, the aim is to subdue, not harm. Before you attack, make sure to figure out what you're dealing with.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: Understood!

talks.objective: Provide mobile support to various areas in the city

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Venti!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Shoot, someone's coming...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Help me! Please! Someone help me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, what's with the freak out? It's just us...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, perfect. I can drop the act... Sorry, thought you were regular citizens...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's about time. I think we can proceed as planned.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Mm, I agree.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Although, it's been a while since I dealt with something this big. It's going to be pretty exhausting...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'll treat you to a drink for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, just what I wanted to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, these two know the other's identity, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: People can make new friends when we're not here, y'know...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Monsters started surging in from Dragonspine during the trial. They soon became agitated, likely in response to the core coming under pressure.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Still, I never expected those monsters to have become this advanced.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The power of evolution cannot be underestimated, especially considering the fact that Durin absorbed the previous imposter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so what about the map? And the missing bodies?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What the witnesses saw was true... I did hide those bodies. As I monitored the situation on Dragonspine, I noticed that many who ventured there came back... different.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Some were under the influence of Durin's power, but the less fortunate ones had already been devoured by monsters, who then assumed their appearance to infiltrate the city.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Most of those who were replaced had no close relatives, so when their behavior changed, there was no one to notice. The monsters used their disguise to get close to people. I eliminated two who attempted to attack.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about the remains Diluc found? Did they belong to one of the victims?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes. The monsters slowly digested their victims. Sometimes, they even left behind body parts to aid the transformation. All that remained of the first victim was a few strands of hair, and the second, some teeth and bone.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The only bodies Albedo destroyed were the monsters' mimic forms. Then, he buried whatever remained of the victims to put them to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Well, someone had to do it. Besides, I managed to gather some valuable data on the putrefaction of the bodies.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: After we defeated that doppelganger whopperflower on Dragonspine, we promised to tell each other a story, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You told me the story of a gardener. I remember.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'm glad. Then, you remember what I told you about Subject Two? In his pursuit to replace Subject One, he transformed a whopperflower into Subject Three.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, there was another imposter on Dragonspine that day?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes, that would be Subject Two. I confronted him and buried his body on Dragonspine. So, you see... At one point, there was something hidden in that hole you found.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But, Durin is becoming more revitalized by the day. Under the influence of his power, the monsters dug up Subject Two's body and returned it to Durin's stomach.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Durin absorbed the failed creation along with his knowledge and way of thinking. Ever since then, all creatures spawned from his power had the ability to transform their appearance.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Humans who venture into Dragonspine for too long are also bound to fall under Durin's influence. But, those effects don't show themselves right away, and the extent to which a person has been affected is hard to perceive.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You saw it for yourself, didn't you? All the people acting strange... Those are the same people who just tried to break into the Knights of Favonius headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Durin's power remained dormant within them until, finally, it surged to the surface and seized control.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: That was also our goal. If we could force a situation where the imposter had no choice but to unleash that power, all those under its influence would become violent. And, thus, we would know who was affected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so... What do we do? We can't go around hurting innocent people!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That's why I'm here. It would make me look bad if I just lazed around after promising to help!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: We will use the power of Anemo to restrain them for now. That should give the Knights the chance to subdue them without harm. A specialized team will deal with them later.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Alright, that's the long and short of the situation. It's time to activate that thing, right?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Yes! So, if there are little secrets other people shouldn't know — ahem, my identity, for example — keep it to yourself, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Alright, this should do it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wind currents? Paimon's never seen this many!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: There should now be wind currents across the whole city. Everyone, can you hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Loud and clear! All units, what's your status?

dialogues.speaker: Note
dialogues.text: All good! We have enough manpower to provide support!

dialogues.speaker: Skeiron
dialogues.text: Requesting assistance at the side gate!

dialogues.speaker: Note
dialogues.text: Heading over now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... It's long-distance wind communication! How is that even possible?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to Lord Barbatos. With this blessing, we will succeed in defending our city!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Actually, if you face away from the current and whisper like this, no one can hear you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hah, no wonder you're crouching down there like you have something to hide...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You didn't have to broadcast that!

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Huh? That voice... Venti? Is that you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oops...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Oh, y'know. Just a wandering bard calling for help! Thank goodness {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Albedo found me! Got me out of a tough spot, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Ah, right. Now that you're okay, we should check on the status of the other areas.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Thanks, friend. May the Anemo Archon protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I've got things covered here.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Ugh, these darn things are more annoying than disgusting boozehounds!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Albedo, {NICKNAME}! If you run into anyone who needs a safe place to wait this out, feel free to send them to The Cat's Tail.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I'll be here to watch over things, so the tavern will be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Thank you, Diona. We'll be sure to do just that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're over there! Diluc! Kaeya!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: If you had time to make it out here, I'm guessing the other areas are secure?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? We can't be here because we care?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe this was just the closest spot to the city gate...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Maintaining control over the main road means maintaining control over the battle as a whole. You made the right choice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what's the status over here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: All under control, don't worry. My trusty civilian volunteer and I have this area covered.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I think you mean the man who held the title of Cavalry Captain before you...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: We don't have to bring that up.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Well, keep up the good work. We'll go check on the status of the other locations.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Oh, and I wanted to thank you for what you said in court. If I'm not mistaken, you were on my side by the end.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, believe me, he's had his suspicions since the first trial.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I suppose it just didn't feel right to believe that someone who helped me in the past could be a cold-blooded killer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, that's so sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Thank you for trusting me and for choosing to fight alongside us. As for you Kaeya, good work, as always.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll see you soon!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Of course! Stay safe!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: We won!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Great work, Klee. I'll be counting on you to protect Eula next time, too.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Albedo, you can't be ser—

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: No problem! Just leave it to Klee~

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Are you going on patrol, Mr. Albedo? Klee heard you went camping for a few days, and these monsters followed you back home!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Camping... Ah, right. The truth isn't suitable for little ears.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: That's right, so I need to report back to Master Jean to settle my expenses. If you have some time, I'm sure Eula would be grateful if you escorted her back to headquarters as well.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hmph... Of course. I place myself in your capable hands, Spark Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hehe, it would be an honor! Klee will do her best.

talks.objective: Talk to the Knight of Favonius

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Alright, you should be on the mend.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Miss Barbara.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Things are still quite chaotic outside. It's best if you all remain inside the Cathedral for now.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: You're not rushing back out to the front line, are you? You're still injured.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Miss Barbara. I'll try not to put myself in harm's way. I can help with logistics from the back.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Well, maybe we can give you a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: As you said, the situation outside is chaotic. Injured parties should not be left unattended. There are others here who need to get back to the front lines, so I'll escort you all myself.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Of course. Thank you, Miss Rosaria.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Just doing my job. I'll leave the Cathedral to you then, Barbara.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: You can count on me!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...I don't really know how all of this started, but I do know that Jean and the others have been preparing for this for a really long time. So, I... I think everything will be alright.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: No, it has to be!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Did I catch you at a bad time, Barbara?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: No, not at all! Did you need something?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I just wanted to tell you that, over the next few days, a lot of things are going to happen in Mondstadt — attacks and fighting... So, I need you to take care of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Huh? How do you know?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Albedo warned us in advance. It has something to do with Dragonspine, and he's our authority on that region, so we should take him at his word.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Dragonspine, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: So, the city is going to be in danger?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes, but the Knights of Favonius will do whatever we can to protect the people.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: But then... Who will protect you?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'll look out for myself, I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...Please let them be okay out there.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Sister Barbara, could you lend me a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Ah, of course! Coming!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Gotta say, when I saw you on the side of the road, I thought you were hurt, not about to whack me in the head!

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Oh, gosh, I'm so sorry about that! I was trying to run away, but I just couldn't keep going, so I pretended to be unconscious. Thought I could at least land a surprise hit on a monster that way...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #I get it. That's a pretty common tactic. Oh, {NICKNAME}, Albedo, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If you're looking for somewhere safe, head to The Cat's Tail — Diona is sheltering people there. Anyone who needs help is welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Got it. I'll take her there right away.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You're doing a really good thing here, Diona! Thanks to you, so many people are out of danger!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it! We all call this city home. Giving people somewhere safe to stay is the least I could do!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Dad, I think we've got another group coming! Can you cover things here while I go check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Of course! Be careful out there!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'll help you out!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: It's all my fault. I knew Klee was fast, but disappearing like this? I only lost sight of her for one second... How am I going to explain this to Albedo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Explain what?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #...Albedo, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: We're providing mobile support across the region. Was there something you needed to explain? You can tell me anything — I hope you know that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Plus, we kind of... already heard what you said, so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just tell us. There's nothing to be afraid of.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Klee, she... she disappeared right under my nose. I'm sorry — I'm doing all I can to find her.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I see. Please don't beat yourself up. Klee is—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Something's coming this way, and it doesn't look pretty!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Alright, fighting first, conversation later.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Ah, perfect timing, {NICKNAME}. I was hoping you three could form a mobile unit to help respond to the various threats in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #It's been a while, {NICKNAME}! I'm also here to help.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Jean and I are going to remain here to monitor the situation. We'll leave the other locations to you!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Don't worry. My scryglass doesn't show the slightest chance of failure. Victory will be ours.

talks.objective: Return to the center of Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: That should be it for now. Good work, everyone. How did we fare injury-wise?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Good! Our preparations paid off! Injuries are few and far between. I have the full record here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Wonderful. I'll review it in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Everyone alright?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Amber?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Yep! Right as rain!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: We're back! Klee kept Miss Eula safe the whole way!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: *ahem*

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That's amazing, Klee! Eula was lucky to have you!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Looks like we're still missing a few...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Reporting back, Master Jean! Mission complete!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Good to have you back safe and sound. And, great work, everyone. This operation could not have happened without you all.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Your leadership is what made it possible, Master Jean. It's been a busy few days — you should take a well-deserved break.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I will. But, I believe you deserve one most of all.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: My work isn't finished, I'm afraid. I have a few loose ends to tie up.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Loose ends... Ah, yes, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: #We can talk about it back at headquarters. {NICKNAME} and Paimon should be there too.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Alright, everyone who has finished their work should head back to their quarters or to the Church to get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Wanna come with us, Klee? We can drink some tea and eat some freshly-baked Moon Pies!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yes, yes!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hi, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Venti! Thank you for everything. I know there were difficult moments along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh, well... Wait, does that mean you saw me running for my life?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh, no. Apologies. Just forget I said anything.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hahaha, just kidding. But, you're right — it was tough out there. I almost lost my hat to the wind several times!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Any notable information on the wind?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Of course! I was out on the city wall for quite some time. I heard all sorts of things. As for something notable, well.. I picked up on anxious voices and a child's anger.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Durin has been isolated for centuries, but absorbing Subject Two's emotions allowed him to understand certain truths about this world and his existence, including the fact that he is no longer mother's only child.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Or her most perfect creation. It's obvious he found that fact difficult to accept. The emotions he felt in response were quite genuine and, dare I say, human.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: "If I eliminate the 'perfect' creation, I will be the only child mother needs." This mindset arose out of Durin's instinct to compete and survive, and came to dominate all those around him.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Of course, the absorption of Subject Two's knowledge allowed him to take a more intelligent approach — accusing me of murder.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: In the end, however, Durin still lacks sufficient social intelligence. The fact that his "army" even got this far is a miracle.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, no wonder Venti sensed a child's anger through the wind...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That same feeling... It's close!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Ah, Miss Phonia. Here to make your report?

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Oh, um... Nothing much to report, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Is that so? During the battle, we were talking about your transfer to the 7th Company. You were in charge of patrols and post-battle reconnaissance this time. How did everything go?

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Good. No problems.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I see. If you don't mind me asking, why did you come from that direction? And why are you alone?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Did you think we were still meeting at the side gate? There was a change of plans. We sent the message over the wind in the last few minutes of the battle.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: There were a lot of changes during the operation. But, I imagine you missed those as well, because you're under Durin's influence, and you have been since your trip to Dragonspine over six months ago.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I... Argh!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't move.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Argh...!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Let's continue this discussion back at headquarters. Don't be scared — I'll figure out a way to free you from his power soon.

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Alright, the others are looking after Phonia. Please tell me you can help her.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I can, as long as the rest of the operation goes well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, the operation isn't over? What do we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What happens next is more of a personal project. I've consulted Venti about the possibility of calling a Tripartite Conference.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, that's a relatively new tradition. Grand Master Varka came up with the idea a few years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I still remember when he approached me about "asking the lovely ladies of the Hexenzirkel for a small favor"... The chumminess caught me off guard. If I hadn't known any different, I'd have thought he was talking about his older sisters or something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Older sisters? Is Varka really young or something?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm... I wouldn't exactly call him "young," but he's not old, either.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: He's the type to crack a joke at every opportunity... So, whatever age that is.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Anyway, the Tripartite Conference is a gathering of three parties — the Hexenzirkel, the Anemo Archon, and the joint forces of the Knights and Church of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos was able to facilitate a meeting between Varka and the mages.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Varka has quite a way with words, so he was able to gain their favor and convince them to agree to a very important request.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Namely, that in Mondstadt's greatest time of need, the mages would return and lend their aid to our nation.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes, and now I have a request of my own, so I need the conference to convene once again. Venti, if you would...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Of course. {NICKNAME}, pass me the Dodocommunication Device.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You're gonna use that thing to call them?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, just watch and learn... Hmm, okay, I think this should do it...

dialogues.speaker: Dodocommunication Device
dialogues.text: Dodo! Dodo! Dodoco!
What's that ringing...? Is it the wind or something?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hold on, that's not the right voice...
Wait... Barbatos?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Varka?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Grand Master?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oops, wrong contact. Sorry, Varka. You're probably busy right now...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Considering I'm surrounded on both sides with a group on my tail looking to turn me into mince meat, yeah, I'd say so.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Well... Have fun with that. We can talk some other time.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Alright, pass along my regards! Oh, and I still owe you for those drinks, don't I? Just take it from my stash. I keep it in—

dialogues.speaker: Dodocommunication Device
dialogues.text: Dodo! Dodo! Dodoco!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! He was just about to tell us where to find his secret stash!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't tell me he hid it beneath the Great Tree of Windrise?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: That seems like a bit much.

dialogues.speaker: Dodocommunication Device
dialogues.text: Dodo! Dodoco!
...Hello? Who is this?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Greetings, Miss Alice. It's Venti.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Venti? Hm, no. Doesn't ring a bell...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You're really gonna tease me like this... Fine. It's Barbatos!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hahaha, apologies. Just a bit of fun. What can I do for you, dear Barbatos?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You still remember the Tripartite Conference, right? I'm calling on behalf of a friend. He's asking for a meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Oh? And which brave soul is it this time?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's me, Aunt Alice.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Albedo, Captain of the Knights of Favonius Investigation Team, requests a formal meeting with the Hexenzirkel.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: And what is your wish, dear Albedo?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I want to accomplish something unprecedented.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: How unprecedented? Something even your mother, Rhinedottir, never accomplished?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: In terms of technique, no, but in terms of location and materials, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, that makes no sense...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hm, you've piqued my interest. I'll be right there!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Be right "where"? Here? As in, this office?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hello again, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hello, Aunt Alice. I see you've turned yourself into a giant Dodoco.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Darling, isn't it? It even has its own hat, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, the attention to detail...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Pleasure to see you all again. It's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Hexenzirkel, I hereby grant Albedo's request.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: I'm guessing you still need to prepare? Take your time. Just come find me at the long table when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, that's nice of you!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hehe, I suppose it's just my nature, darling.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Thank you, Aunt Alice.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Before we set out, there's someone you need to meet.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Head to my office. He's waiting for you there.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we'll find somewhere for you to stay out of harm's way.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Albedo, {NICKNAME}, got an update for us?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You can take her to the Cat's Tail — Diona is sheltering people there. Anyone who needs help is welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Got it. I'll take her there right away.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I step outside the courtroom, and this is the first thing I see? I'm not sure how much more I can take. I'm not brave enough...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Hm, I think you should give yourself more credit. You were brave enough to sit through the trial, despite the nature of the allegations. That takes strength.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: D—Deacon Dahlia!? I didn't see you there!

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Apologies, Rosaria asked me to come. With Albedo running around protecting the city, she was worried you might be alone.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: At a time like this, two is much better than one, so let me help.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Oh, th—thank you! I didn't think Miss Rosaria even remembered me...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Of course she does. She spent all that time monitoring Albedo, it's only natural that she remembers his most dedicated student.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah... So, after all this, I doubt Mr. Albedo's identity will be a secret, huh. Not to the higher-ups at least...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: As far as I know, he shared that information with close members of his order long before these events.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Huuuuuuh!?

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Perhaps I spoke too soon. You do scare easily.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry. I guess I didn't expect Mr. Albedo to just... reveal it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: I'm sure he felt the time was right. Besides, you know the truth, I know the truth... It doesn't change anything, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: When Mr. Albedo told me in the library a few days ago, I was pretty shocked. But, more than that... I was amazed!

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Not afraid?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: No, not afraid. I trust in knowledge and science. And I trust in Mr. Albedo as a person.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Huh, I just noticed, Deacon. There aren't any wind currents around us.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: We lucked out on that front. Otherwise, that conversation would have been for the whole city to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Huh? That's how it works? That could have been so embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: Master Jean, headquarters should be secure for now.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: We responded in time and had enough manpower. We can even spare some for mobile support across the region.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Good. Our intel suggests that the monsters from Dragonspine could be disguised as Mondstadt citizens, so be sure to exercise caution.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, and my divination revealed there are also regular people under the influence of some strange power. Not all of them are monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes, so for those people, the aim is to subdue, not harm. Before you attack, make sure to figure out what you're dealing with.

dialogues.speaker: Porthos
dialogues.text: Understood!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Fear not. The foul monsters have been cast into the void.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein means to say that you should refrain from going out for the time being. We will continue to protect this area.

dialogues.speaker: Parsley
dialogues.text: Thank you! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Parsley
dialogues.text: But, um... I've never seen a bird that can, uh... talk, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Ah, no need to worry. I'm mein Fräulein's humble servant. Please rest assured, I'm not a danger to you.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Phew, it's been a while since I unleashed my lightning during Windblume.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: It happen a lot before?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Unleashing lightning on people? Haha, no, no. Once in a while, maybe. It sure feels good to let loose, though...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hah, my old Professor even wrote to me about that a few days ago. Of course, I made sure to emphasize that I always "treat others with kindness."

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's only natural for a student to inherit their teacher's ways, after all, and mine was a gentle old man from the Spantamad school.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: So, you see? This time, I only used gentle methods of electrocution. So gentle, even Jean would have no reason to intervene.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Huh, gentle electrocution...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You're doing a really good thing here, Diona! Thanks to you, so many people are out of danger!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it! We all call this city home. Giving people somewhere safe to stay is the least I could do!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Dad, I think we've got another group coming! Can you cover things here while I go check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Of course! Be careful out there!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'll help you out!

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Help!! Heeeeeelp!!!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: The situation seems worse than I anticipated... I must do my part to help.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: That doesn't mean you have to fight. Doing what you're good at is more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: She was right next to me, and the next thing I knew, she ran off somewhere! I swear I only lost sight of her for a second!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Klee is known for her speed. Don't worry — she's a knight in her own right. She can protect herself.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, there you are! Klee's here to help!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: See? Kids are fast on their feet.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Those bombs... I see what you mean. She's not to be underestimated...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, was that Eula just now? Let's go to the side gate to check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: We'll take it from here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Mr. Albedo! {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Everything good, here?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: All good! A few monsters made it into the city, but Master Diluc and Mr. Kaeya helped me take care of them.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I have some spare time right now, so I was planning to make some potions to help the people fighting!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: A sound plan.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Remember to be careful. I know it's unlikely, but if you encounter a situation you can't handle, retreat to somewhere safe. Don't worry about the front line.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Understood!
